CA.rationale: Identified content (red positions) co-occurs with a processing condition/origin for the same candidate referent.

COD.rationale: For each binding the report names content (color/positions) and separately states organization/origin, meeting C,O and D for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Processing/condition metadata (command_estimate, native_conditional_record) are explicitly attached to the same content referents' origin, linking processing condition to content presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifications (color-labeled position sets) are reported for named referents and times.

D.rationale: The report lists identified content (color/positions) and separately records organization/origin metadata for the same contents, distinguishing identification from status/origin.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/organization fields describe how content is represented (copied_prior_record, command_estimate) for named referents/times.
